exposure: women with vaginal birth after cesarean section
cohort: 7700 women in the Australian Longitudinal Study on Women's Health
finding: While women with vaginal childbirth(s) reported more urinary incontinence, they had less menstrual complaints and endometriosis.
mod_finding: Compared with women with vaginal birth(s) only, women with only cesarean sections or vaginal birth after cesarean section had less UI but more endometriosis and heavy periods.
